summary: Implemented the TimeElapsedColumn feature in the rich repo without running tests or committing. Changes: rich/progress.py (Task.finished_time field, finished property based on finished_time, _reset clears it, TimeElapsedColumn class, capture in update/advance inside lock, clear in reset); rich/default_styles.py (progress.elapsed yellow); rich/palette.py (Palette.__rich__ with TYPE_CHECKING and in-method imports); CHANGELOG.md (Unreleased Added entries for TimeElapsedColumn and Palette.__rich__); tests/test_progress.py (new test_time_elapsed_column, TimeElapsedColumn added to test_columns after TimeRemainingColumn, expected output regenerated by hand-tracing clock reads); tests/test_palette.py (new test_rich_cast). Notes: the spec's test_columns lives in tests/test_progress.py, not tests/test_columns.py. Expected output was verified by reading only: bar runs are 25/16 wide and each row is 80 columns. Tests were not run, so the results are unverified until someone runs pytest.
